title: explore/sitemap.json: every page the module's exploration recorded. Written by scripts/explore.mjs build (D-052); url, slug, title and links keep their older meaning, the ids and state lists are additions.

id.description: Stable page id, one per page template (explore/registry/pages.json).

url.description: The first URL seen for the page, without its query string.

template.description: The page's path with ids erased ({id}); host-prefixed (//host/...) when not the target's.
